_purpose: Canonical exercise library. One entry per movement, with one cue and one demo video. training.json sessions should reference these ids instead of repeating the movement 98 times.
_generated: from data/training.json — cues re-translated in full from workout_hub.html, 2026-08-29
_gaps: 19 exercises had competing cues across sessions; the longest was kept as the canonical cue and the rest sit in _cueVariants for review
demo videos were picked by search and each one was confirmed live via YouTube's oEmbed endpoint, but nobody has watched them - check a few before trusting them in the gym
sessions in training.json still carry full exercise objects; switching them to id references is a separate step, so this file is additive and breaks nothing yet

probable further duplicates left alone on purpose, since merging them would change the plan: band-face-pull vs band-face-pull-mid-anchor, band-seated-row vs band-seated-row-low-anchor, band-squat-wide vs band-squat-wide-high, band-chest-press vs band-chest-press-high-to-low
hip-thrust-dumbbell has no demo video. It replaced glute-drive-machine on 2026-08-29 when the gym turned out not to have the machine, and no replacement clip has been picked yet.

ab-machine.name: Ab Machine
ab-machine.cue: Maintenance. Fixed ab machine with a weight stack — fold under control, slow on the way back.

video.title: Machine Crunch | Proper Form Tutorial for Stronger Abs

adductor-machine.name: Adductor Machine
adductor-machine.cue: Squeeze the pads together slowly (3s in), controlled on the way back. The best inner-thigh exercise there is.

video.title: How To Do The SEATED HIP ADDUCTION MACHINE | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide

band-adductor-squeeze-lying.name: Band Adductor Squeeze (lying)
band-adductor-squeeze-lying.cue: Band around the ankles, on your back, legs apart, squeeze together for 3s, open under control for 2s. Burns fast.

video.title: BEST 4 Inner Thigh Exercises with Resistance Band

band-biceps-curl.name: Band Biceps Curl
band-biceps-curl.cue: Maintenance. Stand on the band, elbows fixed, curl up, squeeze, slow on the way down.

video.title: HOW TO DO Standing Biceps Curl with Resistance Bands

band-chest-press.name: Band Chest Press
band-chest-press.cue: Anchor low behind you, stand away from the door, handles at chest height, press forward and upward. Feels almost identical to the cable. More tubes = more resistance.

video.title: Effective Standing Chest Press with Resistance Band: Form and Technique

band-chest-press-high-to-low.name: Band Chest Press (high-to-low)
band-chest-press-high-to-low.cue: Anchor high, away from the door, press forward and downward. The angle hits the upper chest automatically.

video.title: Standing Decline Chest Press Using Resistance Bands

band-face-pull.name: Band Face Pull
band-face-pull.cue: Maintenance. Anchor the tube at head height, pull to the forehead, elbows high and wide, rotate externally.

video.title: Band Face Pull (door anchor)

band-face-pull-mid-anchor.name: Band Face Pull (mid anchor)
band-face-pull-mid-anchor.cue: Maintenance. Anchor at head height, pull to the forehead, elbows high and wide, rotate externally.

video.title: Band Face Pull (door anchor)

band-hip-thrust.name: Band Hip Thrust
band-hip-thrust.cue: First — glutes are the priority. Tube over the feet (under the arch), shoulders on the sofa, handles over the hips. Your bodyweight anchors the tube. Drive up, squeeze 2s at the top.

video.title: Banded Hip Thrusts: A Powerful Exercise for Stronger Glutes

_cueVariants.cue: Tube over hips, shoulders supported, 2s squeeze at top.
First. Tube over feet, shoulders supported.

band-kneeling-crunch.name: Band Kneeling Crunch
band-kneeling-crunch.cue: Anchor the band high, kneeling, fold the ribs towards the hips, hands fixed at the ears.

video.title: How To Do A KNEELING RESISTANCE BAND CRUNCH | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide

band-lat-pulldown-kneeling.name: Band Lat Pulldown (kneeling)
band-lat-pulldown-kneeling.cue: Anchor the band at the very top of the door. Kneeling, wide grip, pull the elbows down and out towards the ribs, squeeze the lats.

video.title: How To Do A KNEELING RESISTANCE BAND PULLDOWN | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide

_cueVariants.cue: Anchor top, kneeling — replaces pull-up, no bar needed.
Anchor top, elbows down-out, squeeze lats.

band-lateral-raise-cross-body.name: Band Lateral Raise (cross-body)
band-lateral-raise-cross-body.cue: Stand on the band with the opposite foot so it crosses the body — that keeps the tension at the bottom the way the cable does. Lead with the elbow.

video.title: Resistance Band 1-arm Cross-Body Lateral Raises

_cueVariants.cue: Opposite foot on tube for tension at bottom. Too heavy? Foot closer to center.
Opposite foot on band, lead with elbow to shoulder height.
Opposite foot on tube, lead with elbow.

band-overhead-triceps-extension.name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
band-overhead-triceps-extension.cue: Anchor the tube low, stand away from the door, handles behind the head, elbows high and forward, extend upward. Only the forearms move.

video.title: Banded Overhead Tricep Extension

band-rdl-bilateral.name: Band RDL (bilateral)
band-rdl-bilateral.cue: Maintenance. Carabiners into one handle, stand on the loop, hinge back with a soft knee, 3s down, squeeze the glutes.

video.title: Resistance Band Romanian Deadlifts (RDL)

band-rear-delt-pull-apart.name: Band Rear Delt Pull-Apart
band-rear-delt-pull-apart.cue: No anchor: band in both hands in front, arms straight, pull apart to the chest, lead with the little fingers.

video.title: Band Pull Apart for Rear Delt - How To

_cueVariants.cue: Band in both hands, pull apart to chest.
No anchor, arms straight, pull apart.
Tube in front, pull apart to chest.
Tube in both hands, pull apart.

band-seated-row.name: Band Seated Row
band-seated-row.cue: Sit on the floor, tube around both feet, upright, pull to the belly, shoulder blades together, no swing.

video.title: SEATED RESISTANCE BAND ROW | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide

_cueVariants.cue: Around both feet, upright, pull to belly, no momentum.
Around both feet or low anchor, upright.

band-seated-row-low-anchor.name: Band Seated Row (low anchor)
band-seated-row-low-anchor.cue: Low anchor, or looped around both feet. Sit upright, pull to the belly, shoulder blades together.

video.title: How To: Resistance Band Seated Row

band-single-leg-rdl.name: Band Single-Leg RDL
band-single-leg-rdl.cue: Maintenance. One foot on the tube, handle in the opposite hand, hinge in with a soft knee, 3s down.

video.title: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (RDL) Resistance Band Exercise

band-squat-light.name: Band Squat (light)
band-squat-light.cue: Maintenance. Stand on the tube, handles at the shoulders, high reps, light. Just hold.

video.title: How To Do Resistance Band Squat
video.channel: Get Healthy U - with Chris Freytag

band-squat-wide.name: Band Squat (wide)
band-squat-wide.cue: Stand on the tube, feet wide, handles at the shoulders, 3s down, knees tracking over the toes.

video.title: How To Do Resistance Band Squat
video.channel: Get Healthy U - with Chris Freytag

band-squat-wide-high.name: Band Squat (wide + high)
band-squat-wide-high.cue: Stand on the tube, feet wider, handles at the shoulders, 3s down. Inner thigh plus glutes.

video.title: Resistance Band Squat 2025 - 4 Squat Exercises with Bands!

band-triceps-pushdown.name: Band Triceps Pushdown
band-triceps-pushdown.cue: High anchor, elbows fixed at your sides, press down until straight, squeeze.

video.title: Resistance Band Tricep Push Down (w/ Door Anchor)

cable-biceps-curl.name: Cable Biceps Curl
cable-biceps-curl.cue: Maintenance. Elbows fixed, constant tension, brief squeeze at the top. Covers what the pulldown and row don't fully reach.

video.title: How to Do the Cable Biceps Curl With Perfect Form | Form Check | Men’s Health Muscle

cable-chest-press-high-to-low.name: Cable Chest Press (high-to-low)
cable-chest-press-high-to-low.cue: Anchor high, stand away from the tower, press forward and downward in front of the chest. The downward angle hits the upper chest automatically — the athletic line under the collarbone. 4 sets, because chest is your second focus.

video.title: Costal (high to low) Cable Chest Press | Form Tutorial

cable-crunch.name: Cable Crunch
cable-crunch.cue: Fold the ribs towards the hips like a jackknife, hands fixed at the ears. Slow on the way back — that is the eccentric load.

video.title: How To Do A KNEELING CABLE CRUNCH | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide

cable-face-pull.name: Cable Face Pull
cable-face-pull.cue: Maintenance — the counterpart to all the pressing. External rotation keeps the shoulder healthy. Elbows high and wide, hands finish beside the ears.

video.title: How to do a Face Pull | Proper Form & Technique | NASM

cable-lateral-raise.name: Cable Lateral Raise
cable-lateral-raise.cue: Fresh first — the most important move for the look. Constant tension at the bottom, where a dumbbell would give you none. Arm slightly bent, lead with the elbow to shoulder height. Goal: a clean 15, then 6 kg.

video.title: How to PROPERLY Cable Lateral Raise (TRY THIS!)

_cueVariants.cue: New for her. Emphasized shoulder makes the waist look narrower — the Hwasa effect.

cable-row-neutral.name: Cable Row (neutral)
cable-row-neutral.cue: Sit upright, handle to the belly, elbows close to the body, shoulder blades together. Builds posture without thickening the neck — stay moderate, don't heave.

video.title: How To Do A NEUTRAL GRIP SEATED CABLE ROW | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide

chest-press-machine.name: Chest Press Machine
chest-press-machine.cue: Maintenance. Sit down, handles at chest height, press forward, controlled return. Fixed path, nothing to set up.

video.title: Machine Chest Press | Proper Form Tutorial for a Stronger Chest

dead-bug.name: Dead Bug
dead-bug.cue: Maintenance. Lower back flat, opposite arm and leg, breathe out as you extend.

video.title: How to do a Dead Bug | Proper Form & Technique | NASM

hip-thrust-dumbbell.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell or Sandbag)
hip-thrust-dumbbell.cue: Fresh first — your top exercise. There is no glute drive machine at this gym, so: shoulders against a bench, dumbbell or sandbag across the hips, feet flat and close. Full hip extension, 1s hold at the top, squeeze hard. 4 sets, because glutes are the goal. The muscle that makes the Hwasa look.
hip-thrust-dumbbell._replaces: glute-drive-machine — the machine is not in this gym. Its demo video was specifically about the Nautilus Glute Drive, so it was dropped rather than carried over.

hollow-hold.name: Hollow Hold
hollow-hold.cue: Lower back flat on the floor, arms long. Builds the deep abdominal tension that visually tightens the waist.

video.title: How to Perfect Your Hollow Hold | Form Check | Men's Health

_cueVariants.cue: Lower back flat, extend legs to progress.

lateral-lunge-tempo.name: Lateral Lunge (tempo)
lateral-lunge-tempo.cue: Step wide to the side, sit into the hip, other leg straight, back to the middle. Slow — inner thigh plus glute.

video.title: How To Series | LATERAL LUNGE

leg-press-light.name: Leg Press (light)
leg-press-light.cue: Maintenance — hold, don't build. High reps, light weight, never progress. Keeps the legs lean and defined without making them thicker.

video.title: Glute Focused Leg Press: How To

leg-press-wide-high.name: Leg Press (wide + high)
leg-press-wide-high.cue: Feet wide and high on the platform, knees out — inner thigh plus glutes. Shapes the front of the leg.

video.title: High and Wide Leg Press: How To

push-up-knee-or-standard.name: Push-Up (knee or standard)
push-up-knee-or-standard.cue: Maintenance. Knee version to regress, 3s down. Chest and triceps in one.

video.title: Kneeling Push Up: how to do it perfectly and the three most common mistakes.

rear-delt-face-pull.name: Rear Delt + Face Pull
rear-delt-face-pull.cue: New — this was missing entirely. Rear delt fly straight into a face pull. Rear shoulder, posture and shoulder health in one.

rear-delt-fly-cable.name: Rear Delt Fly (Cable)
rear-delt-fly-cable.cue: Gives the shoulder depth and the 3D look without mass. Arms almost straight, lead with the little fingers, squeeze the rear delts together.

video.title: How To Do Cable Rear Delt Fly | Exercise Demo

seated-hamstring-curl.name: Seated Hamstring Curl
seated-hamstring-curl.cue: Maintenance. Holds the back of the leg — important for posture and for how trousers sit. Controlled, no swing.

video.title: How to PROPERLY Seated Hamstring Curl (FIX THIS NOW)

seated-leg-curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
seated-leg-curl.cue: Back of the leg — the counterpart to the leg press. Pull the heels under the seat, squeeze, controlled return.

video.title: Seated Leg Curl | Proper Form & Hamstring Exercise Demo

triceps-machine.name: Triceps Machine
triceps-machine.cue: Maintenance. The machine instead of the cable rope — simpler on your own. Back of the upper arm, the 'underarm' area.

video.title: How To Do A SEATED MACHINE TRICEPS EXTENSION | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide

triceps-pushdown-rope.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
triceps-pushdown-rope.cue: Was completely buried in the old plan — now a fixture. Elbows fixed at your sides, pull the rope apart at the bottom, brief hold. A defined arm, not mass.

video.title: How to Do Tricep Pushdowns with a Rope (Step-by-Step Breakdown)

wide-lat-pulldown.name: Wide Lat Pulldown
wide-lat-pulldown.cue: Second lat hit of the week. Replaces the pull-up you cut — that would have thickened the upper traps and shortened the neckline. The pulldown builds width without that drawback.

video.title: How To Do A Wide Grip Lat Pulldown
